last_response.tile_description: 1). seamless wall texture of old grey-violet elven stone masonry built into a giant tree root, irregular worn blocks with deep dark mortar, thin brown roots threading between the stones, olive moss in the cracks, hand-crafted pixel art, muted earthy palette, deep violet shadows 2). seamless wall texture of the same stone masonry, with a thick gnarled root crossing it diagonally and moss patches 3). seamless wall texture of the same stone masonry, a few cracked blocks and small ferns in the mortar 4). seamless texture of gnarled giant tree root bark, deep twisting grain, olive moss in the cracks, dark brown and olive

experiment_art_direction.art_direction: The elven stone masonry features a muted grey-violet palette, emphasizing the ancient, magic-infused nature of the structure. Highlights on the stone are subtly warm, while shadows lean into deep violets to suggest depth and age. The tree root bark uses a rich dark brown and olive green, highlighting its organic, gnarled texture with deep recesses, contrasting the structured stone.
